content: Bab-Dummad Abramʼse gochad
Ibagwengi, Bab-Jehová Abramʼse gornonikid, ega sognonikid: “Be-neggweburgi be noe, be-gwenadgangi be bangu, be-bab-neggi-be-gudiid be nae. An bega neg-oyogoedse be nae.

content.text: An begi ise-nued-binsaedgi, an bega ibmar imakoed.
Be-nuggi, bela dula-we-napneggi-bukwamaladgi ise-nued an binsaoed.”

content: Abram, Bab-Jehová-ega-sogsadba Harán-neggweburgi-maid nodegusad. Lot, Abramʼba nadegusmogad. Abram birga-dulapaa-gakambe-gakatar-nikadgi (75), Haránʼgi-mai noalid.
Abram Canaán-yalase-argua, wemar eba sealigusad:
Geb Abram Canaán-yalagi dogded. Siquem-neggweburse warmakdapid, bia sapi-islidikid-Moreʼye-nugad-gwichidse. Deunni, a-yalagangine, Canaán-dulemala bukwamalad.

Agine, Bab-Jehová Abramʼse magarosad, ega sogded: “We-yar an be-waganga ukoed.” Agine, Abram Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila sobsad, ar ade, Abram soged, Bab-Jehová wegi anse magarosaddeeye.

Geb agine, Abram yalagansik naded. We-yalagande Betel-neggweburgi dad-nakwedsik siid. Agi, dordoneg sidapid. Degisoggu, Betel-neggwebur egi dad-argwanedsik signonikid. Hai-neggweburdi dad-nakwedsik egi signonikid. Abram agi Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-baid sobsabalid. Geb degine, Bab-Jehováʼse agi gochasunnad.
Geb a-sorba, Abram Neguev-yalagansik binna-binna nadap gusad.
Abram Egipto-yarse arbid
Deunni, a-ibagangine, bela Canaán-yargi ukud-dummad nagunonikid. Ar Abram na e-maidgi mas-satesoggu, Abram Egipto-yarse sikwas megnad gusad.
Abram Egipto-yarse warmakdanigu, e-ome-Saraiʼga sogded: “Omegwa, an wisdo, be yeerdakleged.
Degisoggu, Egipto-dulemar be-dakalile, sogdamaloed: ‘We-omegwa, we-machered-e-omeye.’ Andi an-oburgwemaloed, bedi be-oburgosurmalad.
Degisoggu, mer an-oburgwemalaga be sogodo, be an-bunye. Adi, be-ular anga ibmar bela nueganbi guegar.”
Abram Egipto-yarse modapgu, Egipto-dulemar dakalid, Sarai bela-bela yeerdaklege.
Dummagan-Faraónʼga-arbamalad daksamarmogad, Sarai yeerdaklege. Amar Faraónʼse nadegusmalad, ega sogdapmalad, ome bela-bela yeerdakleye. Wemar-dummagan Faraón-negse Sarai-sesa gusmalad.
Sarai-ulale, Faraón Abram-nued-akwisad. Sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, moli-uayasuid-machergan, moli-uayasuid-omegan, mai-machergan, mai-omegan, degine, moli-yargan-muremalad Abramʼga uksad.
Degine, Faraón e-negse Abram-e-ome-Sarai-sesad-ulale, Bab-Jehováʼdi Faraón, degi, e-negyaginmalad-sabsur-odurdaksad, boni-dummagan ega uksad.
A-ulale, Faraón Abramʼse gochad, ega sogded: “¿Ibiga wede deyob be an-imaksa? ¿Ibiga be anga sogsasuli, we-omegwa an-omeye?
Emide, be anga sogsad, we-ome, an-bunye. Ar emide sunna an-omega an imaked-nagad. ¡Be-ome na be sede! ¡Be nae!”
Geb degine, Faraón na e-sordamarga igar-uksad, Abram, e-ome, degi, bela ibmar-nikad sedoye, Egipto-yargi-naed imakoye.
